text.p: Chilean striker Sebastian Rozental signed a three-year contract with Glasgow Rangers on Sunday in the most expensive transfer in Chile's football history.

"At the moment I have a tremendous mixture of feelings, of great joy of achieving such an important objective in my life...but at the same time great sadness as I leave behind much in Chile," Rozental said after signing the deal.
Rangers paid $6 million to Universidad Catolica for the 20-year old forward who was Chile's second highest scorer with 20 goals this season.
Rozental will travel with the national team on Friday to play in Sunday's World Cup qualifier against Argentina and is expected to arrive in Scotland before Christmas.
